context: Kenji and Daichi go to a sale; discuss prices.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ダイチ、これ、値下げしとるで!
lines.en: Daichi — look at this, they've dropped the price!
lines.style: Bright, warm lift on the opening. Quick conversational pace. Genuine delight — the kind of discovery you share immediately. Slight lean-in, expecting shared enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Oh yeah, that's a real bargain!
lines.style: Warm agreement, immediate and genuine. Soft chuckle underneath. Relaxed pace, the comfort of two people noticing the same good thing. Eye-contact affirming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 気軽に、買えるな、これなら。
lines.en: Yeah, something like this — you can just pick it up without overthinking it.
lines.style: Soft, conversational tone. Slow, contemplative pace despite the reassuring words. Gentle — not pushing, just affirming. Warmth in the trailing thought.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Why not just go for it then?
lines.style: Bright, decisive. Quick forward momentum. Warm and encouraging without being pushy. The natural conclusion spoken with gentle confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 深く、考えんでも、ええ品や。
lines.en: You don't need to think too hard about it — it's quality work.
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring conviction. Measured pace. A quiet confidence that sits underneath, not on top. Warmth in the defense of the choice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 丁寧に作ってある、感心するわ。
lines.en: The way it's made — you can tell they really took care with it.
lines.style: Warm admiration, speaking from genuine observation. Slower, thoughtful pace. Slight awe in the tone — noticing craftsmanship. Soft exhale of respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: That's a solid purchase right there!
lines.style: Bright, affirming closer. Quick pace, satisfied. Warmth and pleasure in the verdict. Slight nod in the voice — this was the right call.
